title: Woe to you, Pharisees and experts in the law
description: During a meal at a Pharisee's house, Jesus rebukes the Pharisees and legal experts with several woes. He accuses them of cleaning only the outside while the inside is full of greed, of tithing on herbs but neglecting justice and love for God, of loving places of honor, of being like unmarked graves, of loading people with heavy burdens without lifting a finger themselves, of building tombs for the prophets whom their ancestors killed, and of taking away the key to knowledge. Afterward, the scribes and Pharisees begin to press him hard to catch him in his words. [ref:Luk 11:37-54|Luke 11:37-54]
